claude.performance_metric: net loss attributable to company of $(9.6)M FY2012 / $(32.6)M FY2011; CDO AUM placed into contractual run-off
claude.rationale: p4=1: the slice documents realized product/process incoherence — the CDO management-contract product line could not be aligned with the going-forward platform and was placed into declared contractual run-off ("We do not expect to issue new CDOs so we expect CDO AUM to continue to decline"), while the "Deerfield Capital Management" trade name was written off ($1.8M impairment) and discontinued for new products, with growth migrating away to the CLO business. p5=uncertain: the slice reports restructuring charges ($5.9M FY2012, $3.7M FY2011) but provides no specific documentation of an operations-vs-organization/people/culture fracture, so a process/organization pathway cannot be determined. t2=1: the value-capture logics diverged over time — the CDO (drawn-transaction) model was wound down/run-off while the fee-based loan-based CLO model grew, showing incompatibility of the two business models within the window.

gemini.performance_metric: Net loss attributable to CIFC Corp. was $(9.6) million for FY2012 and $(32.6) million for FY2011
gemini.rationale: The slice details the write-off of the Deerfield trade name and the run-off of the CDO business, but does not document any specific disruption at the product/process interface (p4_pathway = 0). Furthermore, there is no evidence of organizational or cultural fracture during the integration (p5_pathway = 0).

openai.performance_metric: net losses attributable to CIFC Corp. of $32.6 million in FY2011 and $9.6 million in FY2012
openai.rationale: The CDO business declined because its scheduled reinvestment periods ended and was placed into contractual run-off, while loan-based CLO AUM grew; this does not document a product/process alignment failure. The trade-name write-off and restructuring charges document refocusing and rebranding, but the slice reports no realized fracture between operations and personnel, management, or culture.
